_comment: Third-party code copied into vendor/, with where it came from and its sha256, held by test/manifests.test.mjs. The copies are deliberate: Sampler.Like.audio is published standalone and must run with nothing beside it. When served under the APK portal the same versions are carried by WEB.Frontend-Assets (/FrontEnd/vendor/: mqtt.min.js 5.10.1, React 18.3.1 development builds) and APK:OS. mqtt.js is NOT vendored here since the 2026-10-30 SDK audit (WS-05): libControl/App/mqttBus.js reaches a broker only through the shared /FrontEnd/shared/apk-bus.js, which carries the one copy — measured 2026-10-30. To update: replace the file, set version/source/sha256 here, run npm test.

react.production.min.js.loadedBy: index.html; APK:OS sound.modules.json packages mixer and midi

react-dom.production.min.js.loadedBy: index.html; APK:OS sound.modules.json packages mixer and midi
